# ReadMe format guidelines

## Language guidelines

- Use only the Italian language, except for keywords and technical concept which are best explained in English.

## Format

- Follow the same format used for the other sections of the readMe with NO DEVIATION.
- Create a section explaining what's the logic used for the main purpose of the file.
- DON'T dive too much into technical details, it's important to explain the logic, the finality and how to use it. 

## Content

- Starting from what the user tells you in the inputs, explain the logic behind the whole flow and how the different components interact to achieve the final result.
- If unsure about the files involved in the flow, or the effective flow, prompt the user for clarification, explaining clearly which parts of the flow are uncertain and why.
